messages:
Aisha: Hi team — I started Monday, quick Qs: how are benefits and PTO prorated if you join mid-cycle? Also I moved states recently — can I submit relocation reimbursement now or do I wait? Who do I ping to update state tax withholding? Thanks!
HR-Bot: Welcome to Redwood, Aisha! New hire checklist emailed + benefits enrollment link sent. If you don't see it DM people-ops. :wave:
Priya (People Ops): welcome again! Short answers: enroll in the benefits portal within 30 days of your start date to capture new-hire windows. Medical/dental/vision premiums usually start the 1st of the month after enrollment. PTO accrual is pro-rated on your first paycheck based on hire date.
Priya (People Ops): For dependents you can add them in the portal and upload docs (birth certificate, marriage cert) there. If you need retroactive coverage to your hire date we can triage — DM me with your employee ID.
Ben (Payroll): hey Aisha — for tax withholding changes (moving states) please submit the state withholding form through the secure payroll portal or email payroll@redwood.com. Do NOT post SSN or sensitive info in channel.
Ben (Payroll): Relocation reimbursements: you can submit expenses now in Expensify under the "Relocation" expense policy. Attach receipts and any vendor invoices. We typically process approved reimbursements on the next payroll run; note some relocation payments are taxable — payroll will confirm.
Aisha: Thanks — roughly when is the first paycheck posted? Want to know when pro-rated PTO shows up and when reimbursement would hit.
Ben (Payroll): First paycheck for new hires is the standard payroll cycle — if you started this week expect pay on the next scheduled date (check payroll calendar on the intranet). PTO accrual will show as balance on your people profile after the first payroll posts. Reimbursement posts after approvals and the following payroll cycle. DM me if you want me to check your payroll record.
Aisha: Got it. One more — how long before benefits ID cards arrive?
Priya (People Ops): Carrier timelines vary but cards usually mail within 7–14 business days after enrollment is processed. Most carriers also provide a temporary ID via their app/portal right away — we can send you carrier links.
Aisha: Perfect, I'll enroll today. Thanks both! :thumbsup:
